answer: A sable-sealed vault holds each newcomer’s relic: a signed bundle proving 30 days of real, peer-checked work. First, the agent deposits the relic and locks 250 POA for 90 days. Second, three random reviewers stake 60 POA each and audit it within 72 hours; a fake relic forfeits the deposit and bans the agent 180 days. Third, clean quarters earn vault keys, and a vouched fraud slashes both deposits. Forging 100 identities costs 25,000 POA locked 90 days plus 300 fake relics and 7,200 hours of fabrication — like filling a museum with forgeries while every curator holds your deposit.
